scope: Fallback only for this root Project Declaration Atom when Header.Container is omitted; not the default for every Atom.
physical_yaml_serialization: not proposed; this preview does not assert that the literal is authored in the carrier.
authority_rationale: Operator decision selects world as the root Project Declaration Atom fallback. Current CA-R-2684 says the Declaration is external to the Scope Unit it declares. Current CA-R-2524 says Project is the root Scope Unit and has zero formal parent IS_CONTAINED_BY links. These facts have different hosts: the Declaration Atom requires its own Header.Container while the Project instance remains parentless.
not_introduced: base Atom ID as a default Header.Container value
